title: Evidence manifest
what_this_is: A queryable index of every report in evidence/. Status is derived: canonical from the list in scripts/build_evidence_manifest.py, retracted from evidence/RETRACTED.md, historical otherwise. Quote canonical reports. Never quote a retracted one.

checkpoints_live_outside_git.note: logs/ and checkpoints/ are gitignored, so a clone does not carry the weights any learned number depends on. A report whose checkpoint is unreachable can be read but not reproduced.
